payload.body_you: You tell {{holder1}} why a certain subject bothers you and {{holder1}} does not argue with your memory or explain why you should not feel that way. You get to finish the story. That can make it easier to say more than you normally would.
payload.body_they: {{holder1}} tells you why something still bothers them, and you do not immediately explain what someone else probably meant. {{holder1}} gets to say it without defending the reaction at the same time.
